patterns.label: Regional (2-digit area codes, e.g. Cusco 84, Arequipa 54)

examples.note: Lima — area code 1, the only area with 7-digit subscriber numbers
Cusco — area code 84 with a 6-digit subscriber number
Mobile — all Peruvian mobiles are 9 digits beginning with 9

notes: Lima/Callao has a single-digit area code and 7-digit subscriber numbers; every other region has a 2-digit code and 6-digit numbers.
Mobile numbers became fully non-geographic under the 2010 'Área Virtual Móvil' reform and are dialled as a flat 9 digits nationwide.
sources: OSIPTEL — Organismo Supervisor de Inversión Privada en Telecomunicaciones: https://www.osiptel.gob.pe/
